_comment: Nested (monotone-in-p) design example. Per replicate, one superset is drawn at p_max = max(p_values) and each smaller p is the first-p asset subset of it, so p₁ ⊂ p₂ ⊂ … ⊂ p_max are the SAME assets. Gives a clean monotone convergence curve; output rows carry a 'rep' column. Run with: python sim_theorem_partii.py experiment_spec.nested.example.json
_sampling_comment: sampling='nested' switches the engine from independent-per-cell draws to the superset/subset scheme. subsample='prefix' (first p assets) is the default and only supported rule; nest_time stays false.
